body: The doc page markdown is generated from JSON files in the CLI repo, so editing the markdown wouldn’t work, and I don’t think AIO could find the original source. We should probably disable the button on these pages.
It's nice to have the auto generated docs, but it's not at all nice to discourage community contributions by making it excessively difficult to fix the documentation.
Why couldn't aio find the original source, @jbogarthyde? I am sure there is an "algorithm" for mapping the generated file to the source (in whatever format it might be 🤷‍♂).

issue.body:
The "view" links were broken because the version used to
compute the git tag for the GitHub URL included a build SHA.
Now we clean that off before using it in the URL.

The links are to the JSON schema that defines the documentation for
the command. This is accurate but confusing because the content for the
long description is stored in a separate markdown file referenced from this
schema file.
This commit adds a second set of links for the long description, if it exists,
which links directly to the markdown file.

Closes #30700
